title: silene oculata
intro: Silene oculata, commonly known as blue-eyed Mary, is a flowering plant species in the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to the relief of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Silene oculata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to exert therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. Furthermore, the plant's therapeutic actions may also involve the regulation of immune responses, the protection against oxidative stress, and the potential anti-cancer activity.
